tasks.summary: The one-line guard in assessDesignResult correctly refuses any chunk result carrying findings with an empty inspectedReferences, throwing invalid_result before the coverage-limitations loop runs, while leaving an honest empty-everything incomplete and a partially-inspected result with findings intact. Both test files were updated consistently: the coordinator fixture's 'limits' mode now reports inspectedReferences:[f.md] instead of [] (otherwise the new guard would reject the fixture's own synthetic result), and a new policy-results test directly exercises the three required cases (reject findings-with-no-inspection, accept honest incomplete, accept partial inspection with findings).

testCoverage.explanation: The new policy-results.test.ts case covers exactly the three acceptance scenarios named in the issue/fix-intent: (1) findings with inspectedReferences:[] throws invalid_result matching the 'rest on at least one inspected reference' message, (2) a no-findings/no-inspectedReferences result with a limitations entry stays status 'incomplete' (honest incomplete), (3) a result with one MED finding and inspectedReferences:['/body/a'] (partial inspection, remaining selector reported via the existing missing-coverage limitation) stays 'incomplete' with the finding retained. The coordinator.test.ts 'findings and verification gaps continue chunks' test exercises the same guard through the full coordinator pipeline (submission validate call at coordinator.ts:285) with a MED finding and a non-empty inspectedReferences, confirming the fixture change was necessary and the end-to-end path (chunk submission -> consolidation) still produces the expected incomplete status and MED count. I ran both the two named test files and the full design-review suite (83 tests) myself; all passed, matching the builder-reported results exactly, and confirmed the three changed files are byte-identical to the reviewed commit fbcd08ecb in the current checkout.

advice: Optional execution: ran `npx tsx --test src/workflow/review/design-review/__tests__/policy-results.test.ts src/workflow/review/design-review/__tests__/coordinator.test.ts` (12 pass) and `npx tsx --test 'src/workflow/review/design-review/**/*.test.ts'` (83 pass) myself against the current checkout, which matches the reviewed commit byte-for-byte for all three changed files; results match the builder's reported evidence.
